reader_summary.overview: Today, the Safari heads to Lone Pine Koala Sanctuary to talk to Tessa McKelliget, co-host of the Trainer Talks and Tails Podcast! Tess has a great story to tell as we discuss caring for koalas and training free flying birds! We also talk about Rocky, the latest resident at Lone Pine...a Lumholtz tree kangaroo!

key_points.text: This episode also features the first time I've played a game with my guest!

 Search Home New Top Charts Sign In October 31, 2023 Down Understanding with Tessa McKelliget of Lone Pine Koala Sanctuary and Trainer Talks and Tails Rossifari Podcast - Zoos, Aquariums, and Animal Conservation 57m Today, the Safari heads to Lone Pine Koala Sanctuary to talk to Tessa McKelliget, co-host of the Trainer Talks and Tails Podcast! Tess has a great story to tell as we discuss caring for koalas and training free flying birds! We also talk about Rocky, the latest resident at Lone Pine...a Lumholtz tree kangaroo! So you KNOW I was happy! This episode also features the first time I've played a game with my guest!
